title: Masoona is queued as a priority-2 Flowable lead on an unverified size estimate
content:
Masoona Consulting is recorded as a small German process-automation shop in Nuremberg with an end-to-end automation focus, and the record immediately qualifies its own evidence: size unverified. It still sits at priority 2, ahead of the enterprise-scale Flowable partners in the same sweep.

That ordering is deliberate rather than accidental, because small is the attribute the screen wants in a first design partner — one delivery lead who can commit, no alliance review, no committee. But here the attribute driving the ranking is the one the record cannot substantiate. The Flowable Partner Finder card gives a positioning statement and a city, not a headcount, so the size read is an inference from the card's shape.

That makes verification the whole next action for this lead, and it is cheap: a company imprint or registry lookup settles headcount, and the sweep is explicitly recorded as not imprint-swept. Until then the priority should be read as provisional, resting on an unverified estimate rather than on a checked fact. Provenance: Flowable Partner Finder (flowable.com/company/partners), mined 2026-08-18.
